description: Unscramble 110+ words against the clock — 60 seconds, scoring, streaks, and a skip button.

faqs.a: 110 everyday words across animals, food, places, and objects — a new random word every round.
faqs.q: How many words are in the bank?

faqs.a: You get 60 seconds. Each correct guess scores 10 points plus a streak bonus, so keep the streak alive!
Yes — the Skip button jumps to a new word but resets your streak to zero.
Type your guess and press Enter or the Guess button. Spelling must be exact.

howto: Unscramble the letters and type the word.
Press Enter or Guess to score points.
Build a streak for bonus points; Skip resets it.
title: Word Scramble Game
